title.en: Naoya Inoue — All Knockouts of The Monster
title.ja: 井上尚弥のKO集に海外ファン熱狂「同じ怪物を見てるのか?」【海外の反応】

summaryJa: 井上尚弥（モンスター）の全KOを集めたハイライト動画に、海外のボクシングファンが沸いている。ガードごと打ち抜く倒し方、相手の大半が世界王者・無敗というレベルの高さ、そしてマイク・タイソンの言葉まで飛び出す称賛の嵐。一方で『過大評価』『ドーピング疑惑』を持ち出す声には即座に反論が返り、議論は現役最強論へと発展していく。最後は、彼が勝ち続ける限り終わらないこの動画の“宿命”を突いた一言で締まる。

media.videoTitle: Naoya Inoue - All Knockouts Of The Monster

comments.author: @NatureBoy736
comments.bodyEn: This guy stay knocking out his competition and people will still say "he's a hype job" damn are we watching the same monster?
comments.bodyJa: こいつは相手を倒し続けてるのに、まだ「過大評価だ」とか言う奴がいる。なあ、俺たち同じ怪物を見てるんだよな?

comments.author: @jessexiong69
comments.bodyEn: One of the most complete boxer in this era.
comments.bodyJa: 現代で最も完成されたボクサーの一人だわ

comments.author: @AskWolfy
comments.bodyEn: His footwork, spacing, power, accuracy, timing and defense is elite
comments.bodyJa: フットワーク、間合い、パワー、正確さ、タイミング、ディフェンス——全部エリート級

comments.author: @StiX673
comments.bodyEn: He's relentless he doesn't give his opponent time to rest. fast powerful high boxing IQ. This guy is a complete boxer.
comments.bodyJa: とにかく休ませてくれない。速い、強い、ボクシングIQも高い。完璧なボクサーだよ

comments.author: @scottstewart5784
comments.bodyEn: He knocks people out THROUGH their guard.
comments.bodyJa: ガードの“上から”じゃない、ガードごと打ち抜いて倒すんだぞこいつ

comments.author: @jglg7238
comments.bodyEn: no one even talks about how he breaks through his opponent's guard and knocks them out, look what he did to tapales
comments.bodyJa: ガードを突き破って倒す技術、誰も話題にしないよな。タパレス戦を見てみろよ

comments.author: @Raptorman0909
comments.bodyEn: His ability to take out his opponents with body shots is unlike anything I can remember. Hard to imagine how he's able to develop the power that he does.
comments.bodyJa: ボディ一発で相手を仕留める能力、過去に記憶がないレベル。どうやってあのパワーを出してるのか想像もつかん

comments.author: @Crowley_097
comments.bodyEn: That was crazy to watch at that weight ! He punched and took the the guys feet out !
comments.bodyJa: あの階級でこれはヤバい。パンチで相手の足ごと持っていった

comments.author: @YCHTT
comments.bodyEn: Don't forget they were mostly world championship fights and against many undefeated or never KO'ed or knocked down opponents.
comments.bodyJa: 忘れちゃいけないのは、その大半が世界戦で、相手も無敗だったりKO・ダウン未経験の奴ばっかりってこと

comments.author: @WitchDoctor87
comments.bodyEn: This guy is truly a legend 26-0, and with over a 90% KO.
comments.bodyJa: マジでレジェンド。26戦無敗、KO率90%超え

comments.author: @deathtoy101
comments.bodyEn: "Have you ever heard of a guy called the Mongsta?" -Mike Tyson
comments.bodyJa: 「モンスターって奴を知ってるか?」——マイク・タイソン

comments.author: @hqp7198
comments.bodyEn: Who would dare disagree with Mr.TYson? I love Pac-Man, but the Monster is way more efficient, and more tatical. Watch his every move, it's not wasted energy but meant to slowly wear down his opponent until the kill shot. No trash talk, no drama, no BS!! Let's his fist do the talking and it speaks volumes!!!!!!
comments.bodyJa: タイソンに逆らえる奴なんている? パッキャオも好きだけど、モンスターの方が遥かに効率的で戦術的だ。動き一つ一つに無駄がなくて、じわじわ削ってトドメまで持っていく。挑発もドラマも余計な御託もなし。拳に語らせる、それで十分すぎる

comments.author: @ebeyslough
comments.bodyEn: Vs Donaire 1 made Inoue a much much better fighter, you could tell immediately after the efficiency, speed and power improved so much, along with his defense. That fight with Donaire was what the monster needed to become absolutely world class. After that, Butler and Fulton were simply punching bags for the monster.
comments.bodyJa: ドナイア戦(第1戦)が井上を一段も二段も上のファイターにした。あの後すぐ分かるくらい効率・スピード・パワー、そしてディフェンスが伸びた。あの試合こそモンスターが本物の世界クラスになるのに必要だった。それ以降はバトラーもフルトンも、ただのサンドバッグ

comments.author: @o.i.c.uvanish9169
comments.bodyEn: When the opponent contracts, I expand. When the opponent expands, I contract. When there's an opportunity, I do not hit. It hit all by itself.
comments.bodyJa: 相手が縮めば、こちらは伸びる。相手が伸びれば、こちらは縮む。好機が訪れたとき、私は打たない——拳が勝手に打っているのだ

comments.author: @zflynn2
comments.bodyEn: I have seen many great fighters since the 1970s and The Monster Inoue is the best fighter in the world today. His speed, power, accuracy, technique, and awareness of his opponent are unmatched. He will dominate for a long time.
comments.bodyJa: 70年代から数えきれない名ボクサーを見てきたが、モンスター井上が今の世界最高だ。スピード、パワー、正確さ、技術、相手を読む力、どれも比類なし。当分は支配し続けるよ
